slides.heading: Pro Tips for Power Users
slides.body:
Run manually first to catch permission issues before they block your automation

Add a hook for sound notifications so you hear when tasks finish

Put 'notify me when done' in your prompts for ClickUp or Slack alerts

Use one status file per task, not append logs, keeps context lean

Deny destructive bash commands in your project settings
